# Learn to Ride VC

> California Motorcyclist Safety Program (CMSP) certified motorcycle training in Ventura County and the High Desert. Bike & helmet provided, DMV skills-test waiver on completion.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of courses, locations, and how to get your motorcycle license in California.
- [Courses](/courses): Motorcycle Training Course, 1-Day Premier Course, Intermediate Course, and Advanced Riding Clinic — pricing, requirements, and FAQ.
- [About](/about): Our instructors, 25+ years of experience, and training philosophy.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, email, and office hours for Ventura County and the High Desert.
- [Book a Course](/choose-course): Start registration by picking a course, location, and class date.

## Optional

- [Install App](/install): Add the site to your phone's home screen.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): How we handle student information.
- [Terms of Service](/terms-of-service): Registration, cancellation, and class policies.
